annotations.title: Clicks Fordeal sent to a shop

description: How many people Fordeal sent to the shop in a window of UTC days (`from`/`to` YYYY-MM-DD, both included; the last 30 days by default, at most 366): the total, every day (zero days included), per delivery country and per channel (web | mcp | api | social). Only counted clicks of people from click_log: robots and the partner's test clicks are left out and reported in `excluded`; no orders or revenue are estimated (own-programme orders are in the partner portal). `truncated: true` when the window held more than 50 000 rows (the numbers are then a lower bound). Needs the signed-in person's Supabase access token and a shop of list_my_shops; another shop answers 403.

from.description: First UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD); 29 days before `to` by default.

to.description: Last UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD); today by default.

name: get_shop_statistics
